items.label: scope
items.prompt: Read only: identify the main execution path and review scope. Return paths and uncertainty. Do not edit, launch nested agents, wait for this whole job, or integrate anything.

items.label: reliability
items.prompt: Read only: review the main execution path for reliability risks. Return up to three findings with paths and evidence. Do not edit or launch nested agents.

items.label: coverage
items.prompt: Read only: review tests of the main execution path. Return up to three coverage gaps with paths and evidence. Do not edit or launch nested agents.
